rows.text: with `p` = qword `+0xC8`, computes `i` = (sign-extended word `p+0xF2` + sign-extended word `p+0xF4`) times the zero-extended byte `p+0xEC` plus the sign-extended bytes `p+0xEE` and `p+0xED`, and returns 1 when the dword at `0208E6E4` + 20*`i` minus 2 is above 2 (unsigned) and 0 otherwise; stored to qword `+0x4B8` of `rbx` by `0023CE10` + 0x179
rows.why_here: stored by 0023CE10, which this page names as the lea site of its control proc
